runners_data.spotlight: February foal; Ubettabelieveit filly; fifth foal; dam 6f winner (RPR 79), sister to French 7.5f/1m1f winner Lagoa, half-sister to French 1m4f winner Luminosite, out of unraced half-sister to US 1m Grade 2 winner Tam Lin; watch the betting on debut.

races.name: Sky Sports Racing Sky 415 Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Millie's A Minx
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning from 286-day absence with major improvement needed after being beaten 48 lengths here previously.
runners_data.comment: Beaten 39l and 48l in two starts last July (7f/1m); absent since and steps up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 39l and 48l, the latter here over 1m, in two starts last July; absent since and the step up in trip needs to bring about major improvement; best watched.

runners_data.name: Kenkelly
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced newcomer from Tom Clover stable with sister to useful middle-distance winner Ranch Hand providing pedigree hope.
runners_data.comment: 40,000gns yearling; sister to Handsome and half-sister to four winners; dam 1m6f winner
runners_data.spotlight: 40,000gns yearling; tenth foal; sister to 1m2f/11.6f winner Handsome (RPR 83), half-sister to four winners including Ranch Hand (1m3f-2m including Listed; 109) and Victoria Pollard (1m2f; 88); dam 1m6f winner (101), half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Passing Glance; interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Clarissa Eclipse
runners_data.note: Debut runner from David Simcock with strong US pedigree including Grade 3-winning half-sister Colonia.
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to winners Colonia (US Grade 3) and Edestriav; market should guide on debut
runners_data.spotlight: Ninth foal; half-sister to winners Colonia (8.5f/9.5f including US Grade 3; RPR 97) and Edestriav (French 11.5f); dam unraced half-sister to 1m Group 2 winner Don Bosco; market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Brilliant Star
runners_data.note: Natural pace-setter from Gosden stable who shaped well on AW debut and makes turf bow after 154-day break.
runners_data.comment: Shaped well when runner-up over 1m at Newcastle on debut; should appreciate this trip
runners_data.spotlight: Showed signs of inexperience but shaped well when second of seven on her debut at Newcastle (1m, AW; 11-4) in November; switches to turf having been off since and should appreciate this step up in trip (out of an Irish Oaks winner); leading contender.

runners_data.name: Fanciulla Del West
runners_data.note: Prominent runner building on encouraging Newcastle form with 5lb claimer Ashley Lewis taking valuable weight off.
runners_data.comment: Showed ability in both starts over 1m at Newcastle; pedigree suggests this trip will suit
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with encouragement on her debut at Newcastle (1m, AW) in November and she built on that when third of seven over that same C&D next time; off since December but her pedigree suggests she'll be suited by this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Close To Me
runners_data.comment: Well beaten in two bumpers and on her Flat debut this month; hood now added
runners_data.spotlight: Well beaten in two bumpers and it was the same story on her Flat debut at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW) 12 days ago; hood now added.

races.paceDynamic: Brilliant Star will break forward from her prominent style and establish the early lead, with Fanciulla Del West likely to track closely behind in second. The pace will be genuinely run but sustainable at this staying trip, as neither front-runner faces serious early pressure from the small field. Hold-up horses Millie's A Minx and Close To Me will settle at the back, relying on the strong pace to set up their finishing kicks. This genuine pace over 1m3½f clearly favors closers and hold-up performers who can unleash late runs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Favors Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Brilliant Star and Fanciulla Del West duel early and maintain a solid gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will stretch the field and tire the early leaders, allowing hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Millie's A Minx and any newcomers with stamina can capitalize on the strong foundation pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Brilliant Star Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Brilliant Star gets loose on the lead without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and kick clear when the pace lifts, making it difficult for closers to reel her in. The Gosden training and class edge becomes decisive in a tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If either Kenkelly or Clarissa Eclipse shows significant improvement from their connections
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomers benefit from the strong pace setup and produce debuts that exceed market expectations. Their fresh legs and potential pedigree advantages come to the fore.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Fanciulla Del West Upset
scenarios.trigger: If the Ed Walker filly builds on her encouraging Newcastle form and handles the step up
scenarios.body: She can track Brilliant Star's pace and prove strongest in the closing stages, with her previous course experience providing a crucial edge. The 5lb claim from Ashley Lewis adds extra value.

watchPoints.text: Brilliant Star could get loose on the lead if Fanciulla Del West doesn't press early, making her very difficult to catch
Both newcomers Kenkelly and Clarissa Eclipse are complete unknowns but carry strong pedigree credentials from top connections
Millie's A Minx needs major improvement after dire previous form but the step up to 1m3½f could unlock hidden stamina
Track the early pace battle between Brilliant Star and Fanciulla Del West as it will dictate the entire race shape
Good to firm ground conditions favor all runners with no specific going concerns in this field

races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners_data.comment: 16l fourth on his return at Southwell (1m) last month; could be suited by this longer trip
runners_data.spotlight: Sent off favourite when third of six here over 7f on his debut last year and he was well beaten at York (1m, good) next time; 16l fourth on his return at Southwell (1m, AW) 26 days ago but he could be suited by this longer trip on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Pantile's Gift
runners_data.note: Natural front runner in great form with comfortable Newcastle win 8 days ago, Hollie Doyle's booking adds confidence for the in-form Morland stable
runners_data.comment: Got off the mark when pulling 4.5l clear at Newcastle recently; 6lb penalty; solid claims
runners_data.spotlight: Built on the encouragement of his handicap debut and pulled 4.5l clear to win at Newcastle (1m2f, AW) eight days ago; unexposed over this trip and holds solid claims back on turf under a 6lb penalty.

runners_data.name: Izz'nt She Hot
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner from powerful Gosden yard, apprentice Catton's 3lb claim valuable and suggests stable expects big run

runners_data.name: Room Fourteen
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare who needs pace to aim at, 29 days off ideal for Fanshawe who targets his runners well, headgear first time could sharpen her up
runners_data.comment: Raced a tad freely when third at Wolverhampton last month; hood added; turf/h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Posted an improved effort on her third start when third in a maiden at Lingfield (1m, AW) in December and she filled that same position next time in a novice at Wolverhampton (9.5f, AW; second has won since) last month; raced a tad freely on that occasion and a hood is now added for this turf/handicap debut; claims.

runners_data.name: Kokushoku
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form, lightly raced 3yo with room for improvement but needs to prove effectiveness at this longer trip

runners_data.name: Joyful Lawyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who struggled over longer trips recently, De Sousa booking suggests connections believe in her chances but needs strong pace

runners_data.name: Boilermaker
runners_data.note: Consistent but limited performer returning from 141-day break, gelding operation might help but lacks recent form and faces stronger opposition
runners_data.comment: Seventh in three novice events over 1m last year; gelded; steps up in trip for h'cap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Seventh on his debut at Salisbury (1m, heavy) and twice on the AW (also over 1m) in novice events last year; gelded since last seen 141 days ago and now steps up in trip for his handicap debut; market should be informative.

runners_data.name: Heated Moment
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare switching stables to Conrad Allen, 130 days off concerning and previous form suggests she's outclassed at this level
runners_data.comment: Failed to progress from her debut for Ollie Sangster; up in trip for this yard debut
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth in a Newbury (7f) maiden on her debut last August but she didn't progress from that in her next four starts (6f/7f), including two handicaps; has left Ollie Sangster since last seen and now steps up in trip for her yard debut having been bought for 4,000gns.

runners_data.name: Crimson Rambler
runners_data.note: Strong-finishing hold-up horse thriving in blinkers with two recent AW wins, 5lb claimer Wright takes off useful weight but needs pace collapse
runners_data.comment: Has form figures of 2221142 in handicaps this year; should go well if seeing out the trip
runners_data.spotlight: Has form figures of 2221142 in handicaps this year since the blinkers went on, with the wins coming at Southwell (1m, AW) and Wolverhampton (8.5f, AW); has gone up 3lb for his recent runner-up effort at Nottingham but he should go well if seeing out this longer trip.

races.paceDynamic: Pantile's Gift is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the rail, likely to get an uncontested lead with the next closest early pace being the prominent runners King Of Berkshire, Izz'nt She Hot, and Kokushoku. This creates a moderate gallop rather than a searching test, with the field bunched behind the leader through the early stages. The majority of the field consists of hold-up horses (Room Fourteen, Joyful Lawyer, Heated Moment, Crimson Rambler) who will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick when the tempo lifts, as they won't need to rely on a strong gallop to bring back front runners.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Pantile's Gift gets soft sectionals on the front end
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his recent winning form with minimal pressure, controlling the race from pillar to post while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground on the moderate pace. His recent Newcastle win suggests he can sustain a gallop over this trip when not pressured early.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine enough to set up the race
scenarios.body: King Of Berkshire or Izz'nt She Hot can track Pantile's Gift closely before producing a finishing kick in the final two furlongs. The Gosden-trained Izz'nt She Hot particularly appeals with her consistent form and the booking of apprentice Catton suggesting confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Rallies
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely testing and collapses
scenarios.body: The searching gallop brings Crimson Rambler or Room Fourteen into contention from off the pace as the early leaders tire. Crimson Rambler's recent good form in blinkers and ability to finish strongly makes him the most likely beneficiary of this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Pantile's Gift goes very slowly and kicks clear late
scenarios.body: The leader gets such soft fractions that he can quicken away from the field in the straight, leaving both prominent and hold-up horses struggling to respond. This suits only the leader who can control and then accelerate when ready.

watchPoints.text: Pantile's Gift if he gets an easy lead through moderate fractions - could prove very hard to peg back with his current winning momentum
Izz'nt She Hot for market support given Gosden's 9/28 strike rate and the confident jockey booking despite the apprentice's claim
Early pace development between Pantile's Gift and the prominent group - if they go too steadily it will compromise the hold-up horses' chances
Crimson Rambler for his finishing kick if the pace is genuine - his recent AW wins show he's in good form and this longer trip should suit
Weather conditions at Yarmouth as Good to Firm ground throughout the card may play against hold-up horses who prefer more cut in the ground

races.name: Infobond Technical Manpower Services Handicap

runners_data.name: Dark Side Thunder
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won at this course and distance in December but recent form has been disappointing over similar trips
runners_data.comment: Challenged wide when ninth at Southwell last month; this C&D winner is not out of things
runners_data.spotlight: Scored at Chelmsford (6f) in December and not so bad as his recent form figures suggests, challenging wide when ninth in 6f Southwell handicap last month; this C&D winner is not out of things.

runners_data.name: Bill Plumb
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with two course and distance wins but faces a significant challenge if the pace stays slow
runners_data.comment: Dual C&D scorer; not best drawn when eighth at Southwell in February; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: A dual C&D scorer last autumn; yet to hit top form this term but he wasn't best drawn when eighth of 12 in 6f Southwell handicap in February; possibilities from an easing mark after a break.

runners_data.name: Ironist
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent runner returning from a 190-day break but has solid course form including a win here in September
runners_data.comment: C&D winner; solid fourth back over C&D final run; she can't be ruled out on her return
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent sort who got off the mark over C&D in September and backed it up with a solid fourth back over C&D following month; she can't be ruled out on her return.

runners_data.name: Caragio
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who shaped well on stable debut 26 days ago but needs others to go fast enough early
runners_data.comment: Shaped well for new yard with Chelmsford second latest, set lot to do; can go one better
runners_data.spotlight: A fairly useful 7f winner at his best; gambled on for his new yard and and shaped well when second of 11 in 7f Chelmsford handicap 26 days ago, just edged out having been set plenty to do; up 3lb but he can make amends with cheekpieces refitted.

runners_data.name: Fenlander
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with good recent second at Southwell who could benefit if genuine pace develops
runners_data.comment: Good second of nine in 6f Southwell handicap 16 days ago; in the mix nudged up 1lb
runners_data.spotlight: Remains winless but he resumed from four months off with a good second of nine in 6f Southwell handicap 16 days ago; in the mix nudged up 1lb.

runners_data.name: My Mate Kev
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose last win came at Newmarket but recent form has been well below that level
runners_data.comment: Resumed winning ways at Newmarket (6f) last May but well below that form subsequently
runners_data.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Newmarket (6f) last May but well below that form subsequently, though not best drawn when 12th at Doncaster (5f) on his return; others appeal more.

races.paceDynamic: My Mate Kev will take this field along as the sole confirmed front runner, setting what should be a sustainable pace without significant early pressure from the small field. Dark Side Thunder and Ironist are likely to track prominently behind the leader, while Fenlander may also press forward given his prominent style. The hold-up horses Bill Plumb and Caragio will need to rely on the pace being strong enough to come from behind, but with limited early speed this looks unlikely to develop into a searching gallop. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and the leader, as the lack of pace pressure should allow those near the front to kick clear in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Holds
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Kev gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays manageable
scenarios.body: The leader and prominent trackers will have too much in reserve for the hold-up horses to peg back. Those positioned within three lengths at halfway will dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Duel
scenarios.trigger: If Dark Side Thunder or Ironist press My Mate Kev from early and create genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased gallop will set up the race perfectly for Fenlander to deliver his finishing kick from just behind. The early leaders may pay for their exertions in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes surprisingly strong with multiple horses contesting the early running
scenarios.body: Bill Plumb and Caragio will benefit from the stronger gallop as gaps open up ahead of them. Both have shown they can finish strongly when the race develops to suit.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If My Mate Kev goes very slowly early and no one wants to take him on
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the three-furlong pole where class and recent form matter most. Whoever has the most natural speed will prevail in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: My Mate Kev could get an uncontested lead and prove very difficult to pass if allowed to dictate terms completely
Ironist returns from a long absence but has strong course form and could be primed for a big run fresh
Fenlander's positioning early will be crucial as he needs to be close enough if the pace stays moderate
Bill Plumb requires a strong pace to be effective but may struggle to get into contention from too far back
The lack of natural pace-forcers behind My Mate Kev could create a tactical race that suits those who lead or press

races.name: Seadell Shops & Chalets At Hemsby Handicap

runners_data.name: Argy Bhaji
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form including a second, should get ideal position tracking Ocean Of Storms

runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise when fourth on her debut at Southwell (1m, good to firm) last August but she was well held in her next two starts (both at around 1m); has since left Owen Burrows and drops to 6f for her handicap/yard debut (same owner).

runners_data.name: Space Bear
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who has been consistent lately but needs strong pace to unleash finishing kick

runners_data.spotlight: Won over 7f at Wolverhampton last July when trained by Marco Botti; good second at Lingfield (6f, AW) on stable debut and ran another solid race over that C&D when fifth 18 days ago; claims if coping with the return to turf.

runners_data.name: Angel Summer

runners_data.name: Love Alive

runners_data.spotlight: Finished off well to win by a neck at Wolverhampton (5f) in February but she was only fifth next time and failed to beat a rival home 39 days ago; steps back up in trip needing a return to form.

runners_data.name: Ocean Of Storms
runners_data.note: Lone pace-setter returning from 61-day break, gelded since last run but could benefit from uncontested lead
runners_data.comment: Pulled too hard on handicap debut over 7f two months ago; drops back to 6f; hood removed
runners_data.spotlight: Stepped forward from his first two efforts when fourth of nine at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) in October; subsequently gelded but he pulled too hard on handicap debut at Newcastle (7f, AW; hooded) 61 days ago; drops back in trip with the hood removed.

races.paceDynamic: Ocean Of Storms stands alone as the sole confirmed front runner in this field, setting up a sustainable pace scenario with minimal early pressure. The prominent runners Argy Bhaji, Eyes Front and Wild Rosie will settle just behind but are unlikely to challenge Ocean Of Storms for the early lead. With five hold-up horses including Eightthreeone, Space Bear, Angel Summer and Love Alive, the race sets up as a classic pace collapse scenario where the leaders get soft fractions. This race shape strongly favours the early pace and prominent runners who can avoid traffic problems and benefit from uncontested fractions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Of Storms gets easy fractions without pressure from the prominent trio
scenarios.body: Ocean Of Storms faces no early challenge and dictates comfortable splits, while the hold-up brigade gets strung out behind with limited room to manoeuvre in the straight. The lack of pace pressure allows the leader and prominent runners to dominate the finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If Argy Bhaji or Eyes Front track the leader perfectly and time their challenge
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get the ideal trip tracking Ocean Of Storms' modest gallop, then have enough left to collar the leader in the final furlong. Their superior recent form and fitness edge tells when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong with prominent runners pressuring Ocean Of Storms
scenarios.body: A faster pace stretches the field and creates gaps for the hold-up horses to exploit down the outside. Eightthreeone's recent win and Space Bear's consistency could pay dividends if they get clear sailing.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Ocean Of Storms goes very slowly and bunches the entire field
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish with all eight runners in contention turning for home. Traffic problems and hard luck stories dominate as horses with early pace positioning maintain crucial advantages despite the slow tempo.

watchPoints.text: Ocean Of Storms could steal this if allowed uncontested fractions with no pace pressure from behind
Traffic problems likely in straight with five hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
Argy Bhaji and Eyes Front both need to break smartly to secure ideal tracking positions
Wild Rosie's 175-day absence creates fitness doubts despite tactical advantage
Space Bear requires genuine pace up front to be effective from hold-up position

runners_data.name: Shimmering Spin

runners_data.spotlight: Sole win from 15 starts came in a maiden at Chelmsford (1m, AW) in September but he's mostly struggled since and failed to beat a rival home at Southwell (1m, AW) last time on his first start for 112 days; now drops to 7f with cheekpieces applied on this return to turf.

races.paceDynamic: Shimmering Spin is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the outset, likely getting an uncontested lead with Dashing Dick, Captain Parma and Miletus settling just behind in prominent positions. The large field of hold-up horses including Grabajabba, Philanthropist, Candonomore, Mister Mojito, Gorgeous Mr George, Documenting, Man Of Desert and Rogue Allegiance will be bunched towards the rear, creating traffic problems in the straight. With minimal early pace pressure, Shimmering Spin can control the tempo and kick for home, while the prominently-raced horses get first run on the pack behind. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic jam from the turn.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Shimmering Spin gets an easy lead and isn't pressed early
scenarios.body: The pace will be moderate allowing the leader to conserve energy and kick clear in the straight while the field bunches behind. Hold-up horses will struggle to make ground through traffic with only 2f to play with.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Dashing Dick or Miletus track the leader closely and pounce late
scenarios.body: The front pair will dominate while the hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic turning for home. Prominent horses get first run and can collar a weakening leader.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Threading
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely strong or traffic clears unexpectedly
scenarios.body: One of the better hold-up horses finds clear water and superior class tells in a sustained finish. The front-runners have gone too hard or traffic opens up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Traffic Jam
scenarios.trigger: If the field compresses badly turning for home with multiple horses blocked
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning crucial and several fancied runners unable to get clear runs. An unfancied runner who gets luck in running could capitalise.

watchPoints.text: Shimmering Spin getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive with no other natural pace in this race
Traffic problems turning for home will be severe with 9 hold-up horses likely bunched together at the rear
Dashing Dick and Miletus as the prominent racers are best placed tactically to strike from just behind the leader
The 171-day absence for Dashing Dick raises fitness concerns despite his ideal racing position
Grabajabba and Philanthropist need the pace to collapse or significant traffic luck to be competitive from hold-up positions

races.paceDynamic: Very Demure will be the only sustained front runner in this field of predominantly hold-up horses, setting an uncontested lead from the rail. With eight of the ten runners preferring to settle behind and only one prominent runner, the pace will be steady and sustainable through the early stages. This creates a tactical advantage for horses that can travel kindly in the early positions, as Very Demure is unlikely to be pressed hard enough to compromise her stamina. The race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those hold-up horses with proven tactical speed, as they'll benefit from the solid gallop without facing a punishing early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure jumps well and establishes an easy lead without pressure
scenarios.body: Her sustainable pace allows her to kick clear turning in, while the hold-up brigade gets in each other's way behind. The cheekpieces and step back to 1m from longer trips could unlock improvement for Hollie Doyle's mount.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too steady and Very Demure stops in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get a perfect stalking trip and unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. She's Crafty and Lady Of Clover benefit most from their recent form and tactical speed.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure goes too fast early or gets headed before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest horses with natural speed prevail. Three Builders benefits from the long absence and gelding operation, while others tire from tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Nightmare
scenarios.trigger: If Very Demure is slowly away or refuses to lead, creating a crawling pace
scenarios.body: With no natural leader, the race becomes a tactical mess with stop-start fractions. The most experienced tactical riders like De Sousa and Mitchell can navigate the chaos better than the 3lb claimer.

watchPoints.text: Very Demure's jumping from stall 1 - if she's slowly away, the entire pace dynamic collapses
She's Crafty and Lady Of Clover getting prominent early positions - they need to avoid getting drawn into pace battles
Three Builders' market support given the long layoff and gelding - any confidence would be significant
Connor Planas (3lb claimer) navigating the tactical demands with Poetic Grace against experienced riders
Any of the hold-up horses showing early speed in the paddock - suggests connections want them closer to the pace
